title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #2

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which angel brought the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Israfil
   C. Mikail
   D. Raqib

2. How many rak'ahs does Isha have? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Three
   C. Two
   D. Five

3. Who was the first young boy to accept Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Bilal
   D. Ali

4. Which is a duty to grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Avoid
   C. Ignore them
   D. Help them and listen to their stories

5. How many daily prayers are there? (1 mark)
   A. Three
   B. Five
   C. Ten
   D. Seven

6. Which is spiritual purity? (1 mark)
   A. Cleaning the heart from envy and pride
   B. Washing clothes
   C. Sweeping the room
   D. Washing hands

7. Sulaiman was the son of (1 mark)
   A. Dawud
   B. Ibrahim
   C. Yaqub
   D. Nuh

8. Which virtue is shown by refusing revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Anger
   C. Mercy
   D. Envy

9. What should we do when a grandparent repeats stories? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Listen patiently
   C. Leave
   D. Laugh at them

10. Rain that falls on farms of everyone is a sign of which name? (1 mark)
   A. As-Sami'
   B. As-Salam
   C. Ar-Rahman
   D. Al-Basir

11. What is a chapter of the Qur'an called? (1 mark)
   A. A surah
   B. An ayah
   C. A rak'ah
   D. A sujud

12. What was Khadija's job? (1 mark)
   A. Teacher
   B. Farmer
   C. Soldier
   D. Businesswoman

13. When should we not obey parents? (1 mark)
   A. When they ask for water
   B. When they ask us to study
   C. When they command something Allah forbids
   D. When they call us

14. What is cyberbullying? (1 mark)
   A. Praying
   B. Learning
   C. Reading news
   D. Hurting others with messages or online posts

15. What do we say when sitting between the two sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Amin
   C. Rabbighfir li
   D. La ilaha

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Describe what happened to Taif in later years. (3 marks)

17. What can children do for parents who have passed away? (3 marks)

18. Write a short thank-you note to a parent with two promises about helping at home. (5 marks)

19. In which cave, and near which city, did the first revelation come? (2 marks)

20. Explain why we should behave well even when nobody is watching. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Jibril
   Jibril brings revelation.

2. A — Four
   Isha has four.

3. D — Ali
   Ali was young and raised in the Prophet's home.

4. D — Help them and listen to their stories
   Respect elders.

5. B — Five
   There are five.

6. A — Cleaning the heart from envy and pride
   Repentance and good deeds purify the heart.

7. A — Dawud
   Sulaiman was the son of Dawud.

8. C — Mercy
   Mercy is being kind to those who hurt us.

9. B — Listen patiently
   Patience with the old.

10. C — Ar-Rahman
   Allah's mercy covers all creatures.

11. A — A surah
   A surah is a chapter made of ayat.

12. D — Businesswoman
   She was a respected trader.

13. C — When they command something Allah forbids
   Obedience is in what is good.

14. D — Hurting others with messages or online posts
   Bullying done online.

15. C — Rabbighfir li
   My Lord, forgive me.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: In later years its people accepted Islam, and many descendants of those who rejected the Prophet became Muslims.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Make dua for them, give charity on their behalf, keep good relations with their friends and relatives.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: A polite note thanking the parent for specific things, and two clear promises such as washing dishes and doing homework early.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for greeting and thanks, 2 marks for specific thanks, 2 marks for two promises.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cave of Hira near Makkah.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cave and 1 mark for the city.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Allah is Al-Basir and sees everything, and As-Sami' hears everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah sees and hears and 1 mark for good behaviour.
